o: Coop and his friends have trained for this moment their whole lives. Now, three epic races will decide who wins the Hot Wheels City Ultimate Garage!

eps.t: The Wrong Track / All Pumped Up
eps.o: Coop learns an important skill that every Hot Wheels racer needs. Spark's new invention sends the campers up, up and away!

eps.t: Keep on Monster Truckin' / T-Rex Takeover
eps.o: A monster-sized guest teaches Mac a valuable lesson. The Ultimate T-Rex Transporter is gobbling up the cars in Hot Wheels City... but why?

eps.t: Party Pit Stop / End of the Road
eps.o: Coop and his mom team up on the track. Then it's time to kick some tailpipe in the season's final race — and it's a winner-take-all contest.
The racers use food trucks to stop Professor Rearview, but they'll need all the help they can get to save the Ultimate Garage from destruction.

eps.t: The Final Finish Line / Monster Mayhem
eps.o: Beating Professor Rearview and his five giant monsters won't be easy, but a Hot Wheels racer always says, "Challenge accepted!"
